card.name: Strongest before predictors of suicide
card.fires_on: The word "strongest" in the antidepressant suicidality warning, in the phrase "these disorders themselves are the strongest predictors of suicide". It is a superlative that comes just before a word for risk factors.

modes.label: Superlative before predictors
modes.description: The word "strongest" after "are the", right before "predictors of suicide" in a suicide-risk warning.
modes.example: and certain other psychiatric disorders, and these disorders themselves are the<< strongest>> predictors of suicide.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning factors or reasons, such as "factors" and "reasons", including Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on the word "strongest" when the text is about to name what predicts suicide risk.
